claims.title: Normalized ES quartic and intrinsic-prime hypersurface
claims.statement: The normalized quartic with roots p,x,y,z has fixed U^3V coefficient one, recovers p=-5u4/u3, and lies on 625u0u4^3-125u3u4^2+25u2u3^2u4-4u3^4=0; the algebraic converse holds on D(u0u3u4).

claims.title: Complete eight-point signed fibre
claims.statement: A distinct-root arithmetic quartic lies in the finite etale degree-eight locus and has exactly the eight displayed signed source points.

claims.title: Prime-marked resultant-one pair
claims.statement: The two signed lifts marking p satisfy LC=H_ES, Res(L,C)=1, ad+bc=1 and 4af-be=0; the other six fibre states mark x,y,z.

claims.title: Turn 7 exterior image avoids the nonproper locus
claims.statement: Every actual Turn 7 exterior state has four distinct roots p,x,y,z and hence maps to u0 Disc(H) != 0; the strict chamber recovers all exterior coordinates from the coefficient target.

claims.title: Seven-state reciprocal suspension
claims.statement: The reciprocal cubic has a separate normalized suspension with seven states and lies on the u0=0 component of the nonproper locus.

claims.title: Fixed weighted-conductor transport
claims.statement: The invertible fixed maps Phi_* and Psi_* transport the nonlinear map, all fibres, deck action and exceptional loci through the original conductor identity T_A,* Phi_*=Psi_*.

claims.title: Root-algebra isomorphism and cross-ratio obstruction
claims.statement: A chosen root bijection gives a zero-kernel evaluation/interpolation algebra isomorphism; realization by one projective map is obstructed exactly by cross-ratio mismatch.

claims.title: Exact symmetric quotient and smooth arithmetic chart
claims.statement: On D(u0u3u4), V(G) is exactly the S3 quotient of the nonzero symmetric ES solution scheme. The inverse recovers p,s1,s2,s3; G is irreducible; its reduced singular support is u3=u4=0, outside the arithmetic chart. The two distinct collision divisors and their positive integral examples are retained.

claims.title: Explicit fixed-receiver equation and prime-state selector
claims.statement: The inverse moment recursion, reference-root evaluation and K frame give explicit receiver linear forms U0,U2,U3,U4. Their quartic F_*=G(Psi_*^-1 r) is irreducible, recovers p and the symmetric denominator coordinates, and a displayed polynomial equation selects exactly the two p-marked states in each distinct-root eight-point receiver fibre.

claims.title: Complete prime-local reciprocal Fable fibre
claims.statement: For every original E or M state, the reciprocal suspension has seven reduced geometric affine inverse points and exactly three Q_p-points. Its algebra is Q_p^3 times two ramified quadratic fields in E and Q_p^3 times two unramified quadratic fields in M.

claims.title: Exact reciprocal root order and interpolation loss
claims.statement: The exterior root order is {(z1,z2,z3) in Z_p^3 : z1=z2 mod p}, with conductor pZ_p x pZ_p x Z_p, while the middle root order is maximal. The labelled exterior-to-middle interpolation has valuations (0,-1,-1), whereas the reverse interpolation is integral.

claims.title: Corrected negative-four-square same-prime transfer
claims.statement: On the exact selected-word domain c | (h+1)/4, a negative-four-square exterior coordinate gives an original same-prime middle state. The alpha inverse fibre retains the material original gate R_s | 4hr^2+1.

claims.title: Complete fixed-cofactor middle fibre
claims.statement: The complete divisor set U | ((h+1)/4)^2 with h | p+4U is in exact bijection with all original middle states at p whose normalized cofactor is Q=h. This strictly extends the selected square words and sends every already-classified exterior shape of radius at most eight to the middle channel.

claims.title: Exact literal-quartic to reciprocal-suspension elementary transform
claims.statement: The literal-root quartic and reciprocal suspension are related by the exact transform u4^-1 V/(U-V) H_ES(pV,U), which is inversion, deletion of the marked root one, insertion of infinity and retained normalization. The coefficient map has one-dimensional scale fibre, the projective root schemes are explicitly isomorphic, collisions and discriminants transport exactly, and the two signed covers meet in a 14-point fibre product. A direct generic signed map is obstructed by the nonsquare derivative-twist divisor; after its quadratic trivialization the projective correspondence is 8-to-8 while the affine chart forgets exactly the prime sign.

claims.title: Exact three-dimensional raw-cell transport
claims.source: Erdos-Straus Project Reader, Zenodo record 21845035, theorem thm:Fable-ES-raw-tetrahedron-quarter-altitude
claims.statement: The retained raw-cell basis maps by an explicit determinant -1/2 matrix to one spacelike and three null Lorentz vectors. Their spatial projection has face edges 2sqrt(3), apex edges sqrt(65)/4, volume sqrt(3)/4, and exact face-centroid displacement (0,1/4,0).

claims.title: Exact odd receiving divisor on the ES coefficient locus
claims.statement: The determinant of the original odd receiving matrix is a displayed coefficient polynomial divided by A^3. Its pullback to the ES locus is p^2 Phi(T,Z)/(1+T)^6, where Phi is an explicit primitive irreducible polynomial over Q. The supplied coefficient point from the receiving-frame calculation is proved not to lie on the ES coefficient hypersurface.

claims.title: Positive-real odd-divisor intersection and exact prime-integral residue
claims.statement: An exact one-parameter family has a sign change proving that the odd receiving divisor meets the positive-real pairwise-distinct ES locus. A positive rational point lifts to an integral prime-numerator witness exactly under the stated cubic splitting and common-denominator criterion; existence of such a rational divisor point is not asserted.

claims.title: All hard-prime witnesses enter the eight-sheet domain
claims.statement: For every positive integral ES witness at a prime p congruent to 1 modulo 12, the four roots p,x,y,z are pairwise distinct. At each fixed p, explicit p-dependent bounds separate the discriminant and root derivatives from zero and bound every signed inverse coordinate and every fixed receiving Gram norm.

claims.title: Fixed-input rank-2+6 cover with order-48 monodromy
claims.arithmetic_application: SZ-20260920-036 places every positive integral hard-prime witness in the open base of this cover.
claims.statement: At fixed nonzero p and over the open coefficient base B_p={(A,C): A C d_p Disc(g_p) != 0}, the signed inverse algebra splits into a marked rank-two factor and a denominator rank-six factor. The exact monodromy group has order 48, the deck group is C2 x C2, and the averaged metric decomposes as a full 2-by-2 trivial block plus scalar blocks on V2, the prime-odd determinant character, and V3.

claims.title: Finite rank-eight collision completion and local ES--paired-root map
claims.statement: The reciprocal coordinate eta=xi^-1 defines a finite flat rank-eight extension. An m-fold root has a displayed length-2m local algebra, a double root gives C[eta]/(eta^4), and the rational ES boundary family has an exact scaled local-algebra isomorphism to the auxiliary paired-root fibre. The original meromorphic pole remains and no global zeta-zero identification is made.

claims.title: Invertible marked odd-moment frame
claims.statement: On the ordered signed-root cover, the Vandermonde moment frame U has determinant plus or minus A^-2. The original odd evaluation factors exactly as O=V_h U, and the complete Lagrange inverse is explicit, locating the additional receiving divisor in V_h rather than the moment carrier.

nonclaims: No universal ES occupancy theorem is inferred.
The coefficient hypersurface does not by itself impose the arithmetic source conditions.
No ES root is identified with a Riemann-zeta zero.
The fixed receiving isomorphism is not identified with the conductor.
The three quadratic-character conditions are sufficient for receiving-frame nonsingularity, not necessary.
The finite-field signed-cover zeta function is not the Riemann zeta function.
Finite flatness, normalization and a local section do not create an original positive integral ES source.
